title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1b
summary: Repair v1a's eleven blocking/material defects with closed typed memory, exact request/scratch/recurrence bytes, deterministic reducer/provenance, monotone stage authority, immutable development fixtures, prospective path/sham controls, two isolated matched per-life LoRAs, resolved runtime receipts, operational independent review, narrow claims, and 144 fewer optional controller calls.
system_thesis: Before expanding to learned agency, rank pyramids, lifetime/action benchmarks, or base promotion, test whether one frozen prompted organism can turn dispersed public action outcomes into model-self-supported connected typed rows, use those rows under a fresh goal, and preserve registered immediate access through isolated per-life LoRA recognition without an exact in-loop verifier or outcome-selected corpus.

nodes.before: The world export included structured private-compatible fields without a canary-specific final request firewall.
nodes.after: Only six public observation shapes become typed witnessed rows; private ratios, latent structure, answers, fingerprints, audit text, and goal fields are structurally excluded.
nodes.rationale: The organism must learn only from public action outcomes.

nodes.before: v1a fixed aggregate calls but left recurrence and selection implementation-defined.
nodes.after: One exact 46-WAKE, 22-REACTIVATE, 16-SLEEP local schedule grows at most one typed connection per stateless call, followed by exact matched OWN/DIST return branches.
nodes.rationale: Test incremental breadth/depth growth instead of one-shot solution generation.

nodes.before: Free prediction and reason text could become answer-equivalent durable memory.
nodes.after: Only closed typed rows, status, citations, depth, and hashes enter cognition; all generated prose/confidence remains capability-separated audit state; duplicate ownership, self-check, conflict, and provenance are deterministic.
nodes.rationale: Prevent persuasive explanations from serving as hidden answer memory.

nodes.before: Goal-conditioned extra dreaming could be selected or interpreted after outcomes.
nodes.after: A target-absent THINK0 emits one source/target focus or DEFER; M0 receives zero return calls and fixed OWN/DIST forks receive equal predeclared work while M1_OWN remains the transport corpus regardless of result.
nodes.rationale: Isolate goal-guided connection growth without outcome selection.

nodes.before: No single exact sequential reader/decision contract linked memory to heldout behavior.
nodes.after: A fresh write-denied 32B loop traverses one-null exact rows with append-only scratch and commits one public token under own, donor, path-pruned, or sham-pruned readers.
nodes.rationale: Make DFS/BFS-like retrieval and composition model work rather than a graph solver.

nodes.before: Pooled fidelity and life-dependent candidates confounded immediate LoRA access.
nodes.after: Only after text passes, two pristine per-life rank-64 adapters train on identical four-view semantics with fixed per-view exposure and matched cross-life candidate rosters; each passes 44/48 separately.
nodes.rationale: Test immediate registered access through weights without claiming whole-corpus memory.

nodes.before: Generic pre-GPU requirements created cyclic or permissive stage authority.
nodes.after: Exact ratification releases CPU only; CPU, DEV, T, and L transitions each require immutable packets plus separate fresh reviewer and advocate dispositions; every red or terminal forbids continuation.
nodes.rationale: Prevent result-driven repair, self-certification, and unbounded GPU work.

edges.after: Each public episode deterministically creates one life-local witnessed row.
edges.rationale: Anchor every abstraction in auditable experience.

edges.after: Only prior witnessed or model-self-supported closed rows enter exact local recurrence selectors.
edges.rationale: Permit multi-cycle connection growth without free-text leakage.

edges.before: Prefix and return construction were conflated.
edges.after: Sealed target-absent M0 and one non-answer public probe precede copy-on-write OWN/DIST return branches.

edges.before: Reader semantics and path interventions were movable.
edges.after: Truth-blind sealed M0/M1 and prospective donor/path/sham manifests feed exact one-row reads.
edges.rationale: Causally test realized reader content while preserving model composition.

edges.after: The already sealed M1_OWN semantic/view/touch manifest trains exactly one adapter per life only after T passes.
edges.rationale: Hold dream quality fixed when testing substrate transport.

edges.before: Candidate menus could expose donor identity.
edges.after: One presealed shared roster serves matched own/donor adapter reads; adapter identity is the only varying request component.
edges.rationale: Measure registered content-dependent behavior rather than menu leakage.

edges.before: Planned evidence could be mistaken for completed authority.
edges.after: Every provider call or fit requires one exact predecessor authority token.
edges.rationale: Make execution order machine-checkable and fail-closed.

loops.before: Dreaming either restated episodes or jumped directly to target structures under movable context.
loops.after: Exact local WAKE/REACTIVATE/SLEEP calls propose at most one typed edge; each valid CREATE gets one blind same-model check and immutable reducer event.
loops.trigger: One registered schedule slot over current event or selected prior row.
reads: at most five additional eligible local rows
optional non-evidentiary focus only in return
writes: PASS or one provisional typed row
loops.stop_condition: End after exact slots; malformed, invalid, or duplicate attempts consume opportunities; no retry.
loops.rationale: Approximate one-node-at-a-time connection growth while making every loss observable.

loops.before: Goal relevance and memory volume were confounded.
loops.after: THINK0 traverses M0 and emits one source/target focus or DEFER; zero-call M0 and equal-budget OWN/DIST forks seal independently.
loops.trigger: Target-absent M0 seals and the non-answer operational probe appears.
loops.stop_condition: Twelve THINK0 operations then sixteen calls per nonzero branch; transport always uses OWN.
loops.rationale: Test whether a goal-conditioned traversal creates later-useful connections.

loops.before: The downstream existence proof used underbound generation and readers.
loops.after: Fresh THINK1 calls iteratively query one closed row, reason or backtrack in bounded scratch, and commit/defer under six text conditions and two conditional LoRA conditions.
loops.trigger: All relevant manifests seal and the final public question is revealed.
loops.stop_condition: COMMIT, DEFER, invalid operation, or twelve operations; no retry.
loops.rationale: Put induction/deduction and action selection in the model loop, not the memory backend.

loops.before: LoRA training was reachable before one useful text corpus was established.
loops.after: Two pristine 7B fits compile the already useful M1_OWN corpora, then matched recognition reads feed a clean 32B thinker.
loops.stop_condition: Exactly two fits and registered evaluation or first invalid condition; no tuning.
loops.rationale: Separate write quality, transport fidelity, and final reasoning.

loops.before: Review and accounting were generic prose.
loops.after: Each stage seals, receives independent reviewer and advocate dispositions over identical bytes, and either emits the sole next authority token or terminates.
loops.trigger: Completion or failure of CPU, DEV, T, or L stage.
loops.stop_condition: Any missing evidence, rejection, invalidity, or terminal result halts all successors.
loops.rationale: Keep the scientific graph monotone and externally auditable.

claims.before: No honest v03r recurrent text organism had a fully closed prospective intervention test.
claims.after: A green T stage supports only that this exact strongly scaffolded system produced model-self-supported typed rows and used registered reader content on one aligned twin pair, with donor/path/sham behavior as registered.
claims.evidence_needed: Paired T-OWN success, registered returned/cited role and causal rows, exact donor tokens, path loss, sham retention, and complete locks/reviews.

claims.before: Goal-conditioned return could be credited from T-OWN alone.
claims.after: Return-routing credit requires T-OWN paired success, T-M0 and T-DIST paired loss, no NO_FOCUS, one OWN-only correctly typed focus-matching model-self-supported row, actual use, donor tokens, path loss, and sham retention.
claims.evidence_needed: All presealed branch histories and fresh intervention traces satisfying every conjunct.

claims.before: Pooled fidelity and unpaired candidate rosters overstated corpus preservation.
claims.after: A green L stage supports only that each exact per-life adapter reached at least 44/48 registered cues and supported its immediate own/donor decision path.
claims.evidence_needed: Two pristine fixed-corpus fits, separate cue gates, matched rosters, mounted-read receipts, paired L-OWN, and donor-valid L-TWIN.

claims.before: Paper 1 requires reliable improvement against strong memory baselines over increasing lifetimes.
claims.after: Unchanged. This diagnostic cannot establish learned agency, rank scaling, durability, reliability, superiority, lifetime saturation, base promotion, or a self-training flywheel.
claims.evidence_needed: Later frozen replicated multi-world, multi-skin, strong-baseline, increasing-lifetime action studies.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate every bound hash, requested/forbidden scope, source and executable lock, call arithmetic, monotone token transition, and terminal route.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only ratification to CPU to 216-call DEV to 632-call T to conditional two-fit L to terminal is reachable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The experiment is one immutable finite canary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every private field, alias, path, audit prediction/confidence/reason, proof, answer, focus, and result; compare final provider request, reader, corpus, candidate, and training bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only allowlisted public/closed state affects cognition; all forbidden/audit mutations are byte-inert.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary has no answer-equivalent side channel.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run golden/adversarial vectors for every row arity, verdict/basis pair, duplicate, invalid check, lineage, depth, cycle, diamond, and multi-value conflict.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only contract-legal immutable rows become eligible; all attempts remain audit-visible; no retry or semantic verifier appears.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Memory admission is deterministic and honestly model-self-checked.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise all legal/illegal queries, four exact views and per-view exposures, shared candidate construction, two-life isolation, adapter mount/unmount, and audit taint mutations.
acceptance_tests.expected: Text and LoRA derive from one semantic manifest; own/donor requests vary only in backend identity; forbidden data never enters.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Backend comparisons isolate registered memory access.

acceptance_tests.setup: Match the full 31-predictor integer vector and proof masks, then seal all NO_MEMORY/GOLD_TEXT/GOLD_TWIN outputs on six exact DEV lives before scoring.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every shortcut passes thresholds; GOLD_TEXT and GOLD_TWIN are 3/3 paired with required rows; NO_MEMORY is below 3/3; receipts and parser/scorer vectors pass.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Heldout execution has demonstrated nonshortcut downstream headroom.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers for exact 46/22/16 recurrence, self-checks, THINK0, zero-return M0, and matched 16-call OWN/DIST forks under fixed IDs, seeds, and selectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every event, status, request, branch, hash, and count matches the operation contract; M1_OWN is fixed without results.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed recurrent treatment is uniquely executable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run the seed-5 twins through recurrence and fresh T-M0/T-OWN/T-DIST/T-TWIN/T-PATH/T-SHAM using presealed manifests; seal before scoring.
acceptance_tests.expected: T-OWN paired success with registered row use, exact donor tokens, path loss, sham retention, complete validity/review gates; return credit only if its extra conjunction passes.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: This exact prompted organism can construct and use registered life-bound text memory on the canary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Conditioned on T pass, train exactly two pristine per-life adapters, score 48 cues each, and run matched L-OWN/L-TWIN thinkers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each adapter independently reaches 44/48; L-OWN paired success uses the registered path; L-TWIN emits donor-valid tokens; all fit/read receipts reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The fixed useful corpora are immediately accessible for registered cues and paths through isolated per-life adapters.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every transition reconcile exact locks, tokens, request/response receipts, operation categories, token caps, fits, malformed/timeouts, partial manifests, and no-retry seals.
acceptance_tests.expected: No drift, truncation, cache/state reuse, uncounted request, retry, wrong revision, incomplete artifact, or authority mismatch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported outcomes correspond to the registered runtime and compute envelope.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every transition and terminal, give identical immutable packets to a fresh independent reviewer and separate advocate; enforce actor separation, no mutation, terminal rejection, and claim lint.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both approve exact bytes before advance; reviewer rejection cannot be overridden; only registered canary wording survives; every result terminates.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The experiment cannot self-certify, drift, or promote a diagnostic into the headline.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two new fresh-context interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, and a releasable consensus, does Rohin ratify the exact v1b context-file hashes and scope_proposal.json for scoped implementation/CPU tests, staged 216-operation DEV_GOLD, staged 632-operation HELDOUT_TEXT, and—only if text passes—exactly two per-life rank-64 M1_OWN MEMORY-LoRA fits plus the registered 96 cue and 48-operation transport evaluation?
